summary: Test-writing (red) phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI client). Four test files added under iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/: repo-structure gates (vendored spec at Sources/ColorMatchingOpenAPI/openapi.yaml, package wiring, removal of hand-coded wire Codable in AppCore) that fail red by design while implementation is missing; facade wire-contract regression pins (green today, must stay green after migration); and #if canImport(ColorMatchingOpenAPI)-guarded stubbed-response tests for all six generated operations (compiled out until the generated target exists). Contract deltas D1-D8 between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110, verified against upstream api_schemas.ex / controllers / router at main) are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-plan.md for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container; the test executor is macOS CI (swift test / xcodebuild test), so no local test execution was possible.
